Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

vegbankr 1.0.0

Production release of the VegBank API client, version 1.0.0 on 2026-03-26.

New features:

  • write validation function #78
  • Support new “minimal” detail when getting various entities #88
  • Document and test updated search behavior #90
  • Fully support the VegBank 2.0.0 write API #92
  • Add functions for remaining VegBank upload endpoints #93
  • Support creation of user datasets #94
  • Add user-friendly upload data validation #79
  • Support status parameter in concept/observation getters #99
  • make upload output more easily understandable without lots of scrolling #100
  • Add upload sanity tests that can be run locally #102

Bug fixes:

  • logical bug when vb_refresh_tokens() fails to get a token #81

vegbankr 0.9.0

First production release of the VegBank API client, version 0.9.0 on 2026-03-20.

  • Initial API development release
  • Complete coverage of read API endpoints
  • Nearly complete coverage of write API endpoints
